title: Viettel Cloud
overview: Self-service management portal for provisioning and operating cloud infrastructure resources with centralized authentication and role-based access control.
challenge: Build unified cloud console supporting multi-tenant RBAC with fine-grained access control at project and resource levels, integrating with enterprise SSO authentication.
contributions: Developed Cloud Console (Nuxt.js) — self-service portal for infrastructure provisioning: Compute, Kubernetes clusters, Networking, and Monitoring.
Implemented multi-tenant RBAC: role/permission scoping at project and resource level, integrated with enterprise SSO for centralized authentication.
Designed modular, config-driven architecture decoupling feature flags, resource limits, and theming from source code.
Integrated observability dashboard: embedded Prometheus and Grafana metrics for resource monitoring and status tracking.
Set up GitLab CI/CD pipelines: containerized services with Docker and coordinated deployments via infrastructure team.
Built responsive UI supporting web and mobile (tablet) access for infrastructure management.
